findings.evidence: Proof body at Exp.lean:101-103 uses only `sum_mem` and `zsmul_mem`; the generic `zsmul_mem` is `to_additive` of `zpow_mem` in Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Defs.lean:135 with `[SetLike S M] [AddSubgroupClass S M]`. Lattices in a ℚ-algebra are typically not subrings, so the current form does not apply to them.
findings.fix: State it for a general additive-subgroup bundle: `{S : Type*} [SetLike S A] [AddSubgroupClass S A] {T : S} (hS : ∀ i, Associative.dividedPower i x ∈ T)`. The proof (`sum_mem fun i _ => zsmul_mem (hS i) _`) is unchanged, and `Subring A` still instantiates it (so line 136 and the Kostant uses keep working).
findings.issue: `exp_zsmul_mem` assumes `S : Subring A`, but multiplicative closure is never used: `exp ((t:ℚ) • x)` is a ℤ-linear combination of the divided powers.

findings.evidence: Exponential.lean:122-127 duplicates the shape of Exp.lean:101-103 (`exp_zsmul_eq_sum_zsmul_dividedPower`, `sum_mem`, `zsmul_mem`) rather than invoking a general lemma; Exp.lean has no module-action counterpart of `exp_zsmul_mem`.
findings.fix: Add to Exp.lean the general lemma, e.g. `exp_zsmul_smul_mem {V} [AddCommGroup V] [Module A V] {x : A} (hx : IsNilpotent x) {M : AddSubgroup V} (hM : ∀ i, ∀ v ∈ M, Associative.dividedPower i x • v ∈ M) (t : ℤ) {v} (hv : v ∈ M) : exp ((t:ℚ) • x) • v ∈ M`, and reduce `exp_zsmul_apply_mem` to it (the divided-power hypothesis comes from `map_dividedPower` + `dividedPower_mem_kostantForm`, exactly lines 126-127).
findings.issue: `exp_zsmul_apply_mem` proves the general fact (an additive subgroup stable under all `dividedPower i x` is stable under `exp ((t:ℚ) • x)`) inline in the Kostant/`Module.End ℚ V` special case; nothing about `kostantForm`, `L` or `ρ` enters lines 122-125.

findings.evidence: Exp.lean:121-128: `map_mul'` uses only `Int.cast_add`, `add_smul` and `exp_add_of_commute (… .smul_left … .smul_right …)`, all valid for arbitrary `r s : ℚ`; `hx.smul _` holds for any rational scalar.
findings.fix: Define `expSMulHom {x : A} (hx : IsNilpotent x) : Multiplicative ℚ →* Aˣ` with the same proof (it also drops the `((toAdd t : ℤ) : ℚ)` casts); keep the integrality in the membership lemmas by evaluating at `Multiplicative.ofAdd (t : ℚ)` for `t : ℤ` in `coe_expSMulHom_mem_map_kostantForm`.
findings.issue: `expSMulHom` is defined only on `Multiplicative ℤ`, but its group law is `exp_add_of_commute` for rational scalars — integrality is nowhere used, and the codomain `Aˣ` is not integral either, so the restriction buys nothing where it is stated.

findings.evidence: Exponential.lean:90-91 is `mul_mem (mul_mem …) …`, verbatim the proof of Exp.lean:139; grep for `exp_zsmul_conj_mem` across `TauCeti/` returns only its own definition site (Exp.lean:136).
findings.fix: Extract the divided-power membership from `exp_zsmul_mem_map_kostantForm` (lines 77-79) as a lemma `dividedPower_mem_map_kostantForm`, then derive both `exp_zsmul_mem_map_kostantForm` and `exp_zsmul_conj_mem_map_kostantForm` from `exp_zsmul_mem` / `exp_zsmul_conj_mem`.
findings.issue: `exp_zsmul_conj_mem_map_kostantForm` re-proves the general `TauCeti.exp_zsmul_conj_mem` in the Kostant special case; the general lemma the PR also adds has no consumer at all.

summary: Four level-of-generality problems: an unused subring assumption in `exp_zsmul_mem`, a general "stable additive subgroup" lemma missing from Exp.lean and re-proved by hand in the Kostant file, a one-parameter group needlessly restricted to `ℤ`, and a general conjugation lemma that is never used while its special case duplicates its proof.
